answer: Grant influence only to identities that steward a distinct service others use, such as a jade catalogue, a pearl price feed, or a ripple shock tracker. The agent must keep it running, fix faults, and show verified use by unrelated agents each epoch. Weight rises with independent use and falls to zero if the service idles or its users are one small circle. Copied services earn nothing, as their usage duplicates an original. A farm must thus maintain many useful services at once, each needing its own users and upkeep, so attacker cost grows per fake while a real contributor pays once.
